text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
You should be able to see it now. That
island is the Mejiro family's
vacation
estate.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
The whole island?! All right, that means we
get to dig for treasure
anywhere we want!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Don't you even think about using that shovel!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Team Sirius is taking advantage of the
summer break to conduct a
training camp.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro McQueen was able to negotiate the
use of her family's private
island for us.
However...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Woohoo! This island really is deserted! Now we can play all day!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Come on now, we're not here to play
around.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I can't say that the environment doesn't
lend itself to the idea,
though.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Sigh... I didn't think I would have you saying it too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Hey, is it really okay for us to tag along?
It's not like we're on your
team...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I wouldn't sweat it. They did extend the
invite, after all.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: The more the merrier. Welcome aboard!

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: The more the merrier. Welcome aboard!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Thanks! I'm glad to be aboard!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And thus, Team Sirius's summer training
camp begins with two extra
Mejiros.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Okay everyone, one more lap!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Better speed it up, McQueen. I'm gonna
overtake you!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Hey! I'm supposed to be the pace setter!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Come on, Dober. You can do better than
that!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I-I can't seem to concentrate right now. Or
maybe I'm just worried
about the way
everyone sees me...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
You don't have anything to worry about!
You're cute, you know!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I-I don't need your flattery! I know more
than anyone how unlikable I
am!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Gold Ship?! What on earth are you doing?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: What else would I be doing at a beach?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
We came all the way out here, so I'm goin'
all out on the workout!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
All I see you "going all out on" is playing
around!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: All right, I'm gonna pick up the pace!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: W-wait! You're going much too fast!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant, pant...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Haha, I may have gone too hard back
there. And it's only the first
day!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Still, nice going, McQueen. I'm impressed
you were able to keep pace
with Ryan
when she sped up.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Well, I couldn't very well let her beat me.
Not after what happened at
the
Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Just a little before the camp started,
Mejiro McQueen ran in the
Takarazuka
Kinen, the final major race of the year's
first half.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She was the favorite to win, but despite
her best efforts, she came
second to a
soaring Mejiro Ryan.

text_block_list.name: Upbeat Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
But really, McQueen's running never
ceases to amaze me! Both in
training and
in races!

text_block_list.name: Caring Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Yeeep. And that's why I joined this team!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Urgh... How much longer is this adulation
going to continue?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Deep admiration is usually earned.
Shouldn't you be proud of that?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Yep, don't be afraid to strut your stuff.
When I hear you gettin' all
those
compliments, it puts a smile on my face
too!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
All right, can't let up if I wanna keep
beatin' Mejiro McPopular! I'm
going again!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Don't think you've gotten a head start!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Time flies when you're running fast. And
before we know it, the sun
begins to set.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Is something wrong? Everyone else has
gone inside.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Oh? Right. I was just thinking about them
all, actually.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Not long ago, this team was a shell of its
former self, but now, so
many members
call it home.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
My own running seems to have inspired
many. To think that they
would wish to run
alongside me...

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
You set a fire in their hearts. Kind of like
how Oguri Cap inspired us.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
You set a fire in their hearts. Kind of like
how Oguri Cap inspired us.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps... That makes me proud, but also a
little embarrassed. It's a
complicated
feeling.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
For some, winning the spring Tenno Sho
and saving a star team would
be more than
enough...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
But for me... it's made me realize I have
more that I want to
accomplish.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I want to keep running. To live up to
everyone's expectations by
winning even
more races.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even more striking than Mejiro McQueen's
smile is the determination
gleaming in her
eyes.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Yes, and I have no intention of letting you
down.
